serving.notes: max_new_tokens 128 is only in the card's quick-start example; generation_config.json has temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition_penalty 1.05, do_sample true. The repository ships two safetensors shards and no adapter_config.json. trainer_state.json sets num_train_epochs to 1 and stops at global_step 1429, epoch 0.250123070527617. The learning_rate field is the peak value in that log (step 145), not a single configured rate. train_batch_size is 8. Logged reward names are format_reward, mcq_accuracy_reward, and tag_count_reward. The linked Weights & Biases run page returned no metrics.
